info.name: SAM.gov Public Location Services Cities States API
Get List of States and Provinces

params.name: api_key
params.description: SAM.gov Federal Government System Account API key

params.name: cc
params.description: Country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. US for United States)

params.name: searchby
params.description: Field to search by (e.g. statename, statecode)

params.name: q
params.description: General query string for state name search

items.docs: Retrieve a list of states, provinces, and subdivisions for both the United States and foreign countries. Supports searching by state/province name or code. Used to validate state data submitted to SAM.gov.
